evidence.summary: The participant reported completing one single-player route through its final encounter, seeing the credits, completing the post-route challenge, and later finding one newly unlocked selection still available after restart.

retention.limitation: This is a project summary of the participant's contemporaneous statements, not an independently witnessed test transcript.

limitations: This is participant attestation rather than instrumented proof.
The acceptance session was unstructured and does not establish absence of defects.
The statement supports only the exercised route and one persisted unlock state.
